name: Coolify
title: Coolify: self-host your own Vercel for free
job: Your own Vercel, on your server
caption:
Vercel Pro is $20/month per seat. Coolify gives you the same push-to-deploy flow on your own server, for free 🚀

✅ git push → deploy, with pull-request previews
✅ Automatic HTTPS and custom domains
✅ Databases + 360+ one-click services
✅ No lock-in: stop using Coolify and your apps keep running

💻 Any server you can SSH into: a VPS, bare metal, even a Raspberry Pi
ℹ️ Coolify itself is free, but you pay for (or own) the server it runs on. There's also a paid Coolify Cloud if you don't want to host the dashboard yourself

Comment "DEPLOY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for open-source finds that save developers money

dm_pitch: Coolify, the free self-hosted alternative to Vercel 🚀

thumb.line: free, on any server you own

beats.say: This one command turns any server you own into your own Vercel.
It's called Coolify. Free, open source, and it runs on your hardware.
Vercel Pro is twenty dollars a month per seat. Coolify costs nothing.
Push to Git and it deploys. Pull requests get previews. And HTTPS is automatic.
It runs your databases too, plus more than three hundred and sixty one click services.
beats.label: one-click services

beats.say: And if you ever stop using it, your apps keep running.
Comment Deploy, and I'll send you the link.
